findings.location: docs/plans/2026-11-08-safe-git-commit-repeat-staged-set-check.md: Scope; Completion criterion 5; Increment A step 5
findings.problem: The plan makes the security review mandatory and directs the agent to run the `security-reviewer`. Project policy requires a stop to ask the owner whether to run a security review, and permits the review only after the owner asks. As written, completing the plan requires an unauthorized action.
findings.suggestion: Replace the mandatory review with an owner checkpoint that states the concrete index/subprocess risk and proposes the installed `security-review` capability; run the review and make its result a completion requirement only if the owner authorizes it.

summary: The implementation and spec-update plan aligns with the named candidate and specs, but its mandatory security-review step conflicts with the required owner authorization checkpoint.
